claims: France faces Colombia in a "Road to 26" international friendly on Sunday, March 29, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. ET at Northwest Stadium in Landover, Maryland.
Northwest Stadium is in the Washington D.C. area.
Tickets are currently on sale via SeatGeek and Ticketmaster.
The match is broadcast or streamed on Telemundo and NBC Universo.
France is coming off a competitive March friendly window, including a win against Brazil, as highlighted by World Soccer Talk.
Colombia won 3-2 against France in 2018, noted in data from Transfermarkt.
France won 1-0 against Colombia in 2008, noted in data from Transfermarkt.
The match is part of the preparation for the 2026 World Cup, as reported by Ticket News.
